answer: Concretely: an identity must post a bond earned from earlier graded work, and every voucher for a new account draws from that voucher's own bond. A sybil farm therefore cannot mint free puppets - it must sink real labour into each one and lock stake behind every voucher. When a jury finds a single forged relic in the chain, the slash runs both ways: the puppet's bond and the voucher's remaining stake are burnt and onyx-marked for auditors. Cost of N fakes grows as N x labour + forfeited stake, while the mesa of staked graders re-checks each bond claim.
